description:
The 'TaskTracker' app has a placeholder 'Settings' button on the Home screen that currently does nothing. Your task is to implement the Settings screen and wire it up.

1. Create a new Fragment named 'SettingsFragment' in 'com.example.tasktracker' with a corresponding layout file 'fragment_settings.xml'.
2. Open 'res/navigation/nav_graph.xml' and add the new fragment as a destination with the ID 'settingsFragment'.
3. Create an action in the 'homeFragment' destination with ID 'action_home_to_settings' that points to the 'settingsFragment'.
4. In 'HomeFragment.kt', locate the 'btn_settings' OnClickListener and implement the navigation using 'findNavController().navigate(...)'.

Ensure the project builds successfully when you are done.
